briefdescription.para: Axis along which the gradient color varies: Qt.Horizontal for X values, Qt.Vertical for Y values. Default: Qt.Horizontal.
A Qt Gradient (or compatible) object supplying the color stops.
Colormap supplying the color stops. Overrides gradient when set.

detaileddescription.para: Only the ramp is used. Colormap::min, Colormap::max, and Colormap::logScale are ignored; valueMin and valueMax place the ramp instead.

briefdescription.para: Data value at gradient position 0. Unset by default: the smallest value of each series along direction, or of its axis data range when the series has no valid data point.

detaileddescription.para: Reads NaN while unset; assign undefined to unset it.

briefdescription.para: Data value at gradient position 1. Unset by default: the largest value of each series along direction, or of its axis data range when the series has no valid data point.

detaileddescription.para: Reads NaN while unset; assign undefined to unset it.

briefdescription.para: Y data value the filled area starts from. Unset by default: the smallest visible value of each series' Y axis, so the fill follows panning and zooming.

detaileddescription.para: Reads NaN while unset; assign undefined to unset it.

briefdescription.para: Overall opacity of the fill area in [0, 1]. Default: 0.35.

detaileddescription.para: Applies to the fill only. The curve's opacity and the opacity of its parent items also apply, so the rendered fill alpha is the product of all of them.

briefdescription.para: Constructs a GradientFill with the given parent.
Returns the gradient direction.

Returns the data value at gradient position 0, or NaN when each series' data range applies.
Sets the data value at gradient position 0 to value. NaN unsets it.
Unsets the value at gradient position 0, so each series' data range applies again.
Returns the data value at gradient position 1, or NaN when each series' data range applies.
Sets the data value at gradient position 1 to value. NaN unsets it.
Unsets the value at gradient position 1, so each series' data range applies again.
Returns the baseline data value, or NaN when the fill starts at the smallest visible Y value.
Sets the baseline data value to value. NaN unsets it.
Unsets the baseline, so the fill starts at the smallest visible Y value again.
Returns the fill opacity.
Sets the fill opacity to value.
Returns a snapshot of all fill parameters, updated on the GUI thread when the effect changes.

detaileddescription.para: Does not read the QML gradient, so updatePaintNode() can call it on the render thread.

briefdescription.para: Re-reads the gradient stops, which can change without a notification, and emits effectChanged() if they differ from the snapshot.
Emitted when the direction property changes.
Emitted when the gradient property changes.
Emitted when the colormap property changes.
Emitted when the valueMin property changes.
Emitted when the valueMax property changes.
Emitted when the baselineValue property changes.
Emitted when the opacity property changes.
A LineCurve effect that fills the area under the curve with a color gradient.

detaileddescription.para: Attach to LineCurve::effects to render a shaded fill between the curve and a configurable baseline. The color stops come from colormap when set, otherwise from a Qt Gradient assigned to gradient. direction sets the axis the colors vary along.
